examples.en: I can't make it until I have first-hand information on prices.
examples.zh: 除非我有第一手的价格信息，否则我无法成功。

examples.en: We've been through Germany and seen first-hand what's happening there.
examples.zh: 我们曾走遍德国，亲眼目睹了那里发生的事。

examples.en: I experienced Italian hospitality first-hand on a crowded railway.
examples.zh: 在拥挤的火车上，我亲身体验到了意大利人的热情好客。
